definition.name: Actual signed Go condition, lock, select and retirement controls

steps.name: Check finite source and fail-closed execution contracts
Install captured compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the exact maintained compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "ecbadb99091a3f46e31f5f934b068b1864eafa7995211b39eaddf76996045fe5  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go-async"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile ordinary synchronization with the actual v5 runtime and native reference
Compile the identical source without compiler checkpoints
Run the one real signed synchronization and retirement target
Retain bounded actual results and compiler source identities

with.name: go-synchronization-reference-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-result/receipt.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-result/signed.stdout.log
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-result/signed.stderr.log
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization/GO-ACTIVATION-COMPILE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization/GO-ACTIVATION-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization/logs/
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-negative/GO-ACTIVATION-COMPILE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-negative/GO-ACTIVATION-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-synchronization-negative/logs/

reviewReason: Add finite actual Go synchronization/retirement source/native/signed controls under unchanged v5 task/wait/maintenance capacities. Preserve every existing Go workflow command and artifact, profile and source guard; no pass claim before actual execution.
